messages:
Aisha (PM): Quick quarterly huddle — want to capture what actually shipped, what slipped, and clear owners for follow-ups. I'll list things then ping for updates.
Ben (Eng): sounds good, go for it.
Aisha (PM): Shipped: 1) Hosted API v1 routing policies (canary + fallback) — product + eng. 2) Streaming SDK improvements (latency smoothing). 3) Console: per-route cost breakdown (beta).
Maya (Design): Confirmed: console cost UI is in beta and we got UX sign-off for the next iteration. Small tweaks pending on mobile view.
Ben (Eng): Slipped: Dedicated autoscale (p95 throughput target). Blocked by kernel selection changes from eng-runtime — that landed late. ETA pushed to next sprint.
Carla (Eng-Infra): Correction: kernel selector landed but created a regression in cert rotation tests, so infra had to pause the autoscale rollout. We're on it, root cause is kexec path mismatch.
Ryan (Eng-Platform): Dependency note: Dedicated autoscale also needs the new deployment policies from platform (route-based capacity assignment). Ben/Carla we need a pairing session this week.
Ben (Eng): @Ryan + @Carla yep. I can carve out 2 hours Friday to pair.
Carla (Eng-Infra): Friday 10–12 PT works for me. I'll bring the failing logs and a dump of the kexec traces.
Aisha (PM): Ownership clarity: Ben owns Dedicated autoscale feature work, Carla owns infra fixes, Ryan owns deployment policy integration. I'll own cross-team comms and customer updates. Marking this as an action item.
SRE-Bot: Incident note created: #INC-2026-378 — cert-rotation regression (linked to autoscale staging).
Maya (Design): For shipped console cost UI, I'll iterate on mobile adjustments and push a small PR by Wed.
Ben (Eng): Quick code review ask: I left a small TODO in the autoscale PR about batching heuristics. Can someone from platform glance? diff: https://git.redwood/eng/auto-pr/542
Ryan (Eng-Platform): I'll review tonight, will comment inline. If we need a quick change, tag me with @Ryan (review) so I get a notif.
Aisha (PM): Risks: 1) Dedicated autoscale slip affects a handful of early enterprise customers expecting burst SLAs. 2) Cert-rotation regression could delay Dedicated GA. We should draft a short customer update if the fix will take >72 hrs.
Ben (Eng): Agreed on customer comms. I'll estimate fix time after Friday pairing and tag customer-success.
Carla (Eng-Infra): Preliminary fix estimate: 1–2 sprints if we need a kernel backport; ~3 days if it's a config patch. Will know after Friday.
Aisha (PM): Next steps (ASAP): - Friday pairing session (Ben + Carla + Ryan) - Maya to ship console mobile PR by Wed - Ben to post autoscale patch ETA after pairing - I will draft a short customer note if ETA > 72h.
Ryan (Eng-Platform): Added the pairing to my calendar. Also suggest we add a rollout rollback plan snippet to the PR: small script: 
```
# rollback example
kubectl apply -f rollout-previous.yaml
sleep 30
kubectl get pods -l app=dedicated --watch
```
Ben (Eng): Nice, will include rollback snippet.
Aisha (PM): Thanks all. If anyone needs to change owners, shout here. Otherwise I'll convert these into a short tracker and share later today. :thumbsup:
Ben (Eng): Thanks — will update status after pairing.
Carla (Eng-Infra): Thanks, team.
Maya (Design): On it.
SRE-Bot: Reminder: weekly oncall handoff tomorrow at 9am PT.
